gosa_base_url.description: The fully qualified URL where the GOsa² web interface is accessible (must end with a slash).

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI. Supports ldap://, ldaps://, or ldap+ssl:// schemes.

ldap_basedn.description: Base distinguished name (DN) where GOsa² will look up users, groups, and other LDAP objects.

ldap_binddn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP server with administrative privileges.

ldap_bindpw.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN. *Never commit this value to source control.* Use a secrets manager or secure vault.

ldap_use_tls.description: If true, enables StartTLS after connecting to the LDAP server (non-secure port).

ldap_tls_check_peer.description: If true (recommended), verify the LDAP server's TLS certificate against trusted CAs.

ldap_tls_cacertfile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle or file for validating LDAPS/TLS server certificates. Leave empty to use system defaults.

session_timeout.description: LDAP session timeout in seconds. After this time of inactivity, the session will expire.

default_lang.description: Default language for the interface (ISO 639-1 two-letter code).

debug.description: If true, enable verbose debugging output. Do *not* enable in production.

posix_support.description: Enable support for POSIX user/group schemas (e.g., uidNumber, gidNumber, homeDirectory).

samba_support.description: Enable Samba schema support for Windows domain integration (e.g., SID, uid, ntPassword).

ssh_support.description: Enable SSH public key management in user profiles.

admin_group_dn.description: DN of the LDAP group whose members are granted full GOsa² administration rights.

user_attribute.description: LDAP attribute used as the unique username identifier (e.g., uid, mail).

user_display_attribute.description: LDAP attribute used to display user names in the UI (e.g., cn, displayName).

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for log messages.

log_file.description: Path to the GOsa² log file. Use empty string ('') to log to stdout/stderr instead.

log_syslog.description: If true, send logs to the system syslog facility in addition to the log file.

plugins.description: List of GOsa² plugin names to enable. Plugins extend functionality (e.g., account management, DNS zone editing).

description.description: Human-readable description of the plugin's purpose (shown in UI/wizard).

options.description: Key-value plugin configuration parameters. Format and keys vary per plugin.

plugins_config.description: Configuration for each enabled plugin. Each item defines name, description, and options for a plugin.

sudoers_enabled.description: Enable sudoers (sudo command scheduling) management via GOsa².

sudoers_basedn.description: Base DN for sudoers entries in LDAP.

sudoers_role_dn.description: DN of the default sudoers role entry.

sudoers_host_attr.description: LDAP attribute used to specify hosts in sudoers entries.
